name: omd-browser
description: Persistent, policy-guarded browser sessions over OMD's managed Chromium, with ref-based snapshots, proof screenshots, live handoff and an opt-in login vault and CAPTCHA helpers.

interface.longDescription: Named browser sessions keep cookies and tabs across calls. Compact snapshots name elements by ref, screenshots record proof, private and cloud-metadata destinations are blocked by default, and a live view hands the page to the user. The login vault and CAPTCHA helpers stay off until enabled per profile.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the page in the OMD browser and check it
